events.title: Silent Mainland on Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Silent Mainland is a roguelike deckbuilder fought on a grid, and it’s officially joining Steam Next Fest!Fans of Slay the Spire and Monster Train, don’t miss this one. The demo features full content. Face endless waves of enemies, build your deck and overcome tough foes. Every run delivers a fresh, randomized experience!Come and try it out, and feel free to share your gameplay impressions and suggestions with us.Discord: Jion us
